simple.meaning: לֶחֶם (lechem) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “food (for man or beast), especially bread , or grain (for making it).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 299 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 3:19. Its contexts include family line, kingship, priesthood, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לֶחֶם (H3899).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: לֶחֶם (lechem) / H3899 is traced through Genesis 3:19, Genesis 14:18, Genesis 18:5, Genesis 21:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.
